title: Rajnath Singh to review performance of 16 DPSUs; turnover rises 15.4% to ₹1.29 lakh crore
description: According to the Defence Ministry, the cumulative Profit After Tax of the DPSUs stood at ₹23,136 crore during FY 2025-26, a 15.6% growth over the previous financial year. The DPSUs also recorded a sharp increase in exports, which grew by 151.2% compared to FY 2024-25
